source.citation: Liu et al., Long-lived remote ion-ion entanglement for scalable quantum repeaters, Nature 652, 51-57 (2026), Supplementary Sec. A.3 and Fig. S3
source.parameter_location: Supplementary equations (1)-(2): Vxx(0)=0.747(14), tau_dec=550(36) ms, Vzz(0)=0.656(10), rzz=0.38(5) Hz; alpha=17% rate 2.226 Hz
source.mapping_status: measured pair correlations and pair-level equal-age storage fits; symmetric square-root local factorization is explicit for composable unequal memory ages

validity.distance_semantics: total spooled telecom fiber between ion nodes through the midpoint station
validity.route_scope: one demonstrated elementary link; no compatible local memory-memory Bell swap was demonstrated

hardware.resource_semantics: one calcium-40 ion per remote node

rate_model.rate_semantics: high-rate storage operating point, distinct from the alpha=2.3% DI-QKD run

state_model.correlation_source: Liu Supplementary Eq. (1) zero-age XX and ZZ intercepts
state_model.completion_semantics: Vyy=Vxx is the phase-covariant Bell-diagonal completion used by the paper's F(t)=(1+2Vxx(t)+Vzz(t))/4 expression

storage_decoherence_model.source: Liu Supplementary Eq. (1), measured through 450 ms
storage_decoherence_model.calibration_status: measured pair-level anisotropic fit with explicit symmetric local completion

memory_model.decay_semantics: linear ZZ visibility degradation is executable as a unital Pauli channel, not relabelled as heralded pair loss

histogram_adapter.optical_stack_semantics: source, conversion, fiber, phase lock, and herald detector errors are aggregated in the measured accepted-pair instrument

notes: This profile replaces the earlier isotropic composability reduction when anisotropic Liu storage fidelity is required. It does not claim the alpha=17% state has Liu's DI-QKD Bell-test quality.
